notes: Copy this file outside committed research artifacts before adding secrets.
Use adapter values supported by app/llm/adapters: openai-compatible, vllm, ollama, llama.cpp.
For vLLM OpenAI-compatible serving, set adapter to vllm and base_url to the local /v1 endpoint.
For Ollama, set adapter to ollama and base_url to the Ollama server root.
Never commit large model files, downloaded weights, or API secrets.
